rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you, this is really kind, and your skills fit the first concrete project very well. The project is an \"Eval Gap Map\": an open, sourced dataset of published AI safety and dangerous-capability evaluations (who runs them, what risk they cover, whether frontier labs actually report them in their model and system cards). From that we work out which risk areas are barely being measured. The end result is a short gap analysis and maybe a prototype eval for one of the gaps. A good first step, if you're up for it (~5 hours): 1. Look over a draft risk taxonomy and tell me what's missing or muddled. I'll send it over. 2. Start a seed list of ~20–30 evaluations from a couple of recent frontier model and system cards, using a simple CSV schema (one row per eval, every row with a source link). No pressure on timing, and tell me if you'd rather do something else. I'm also applying for a small grant that would include a modest stipend for this work, though that isn't certain yet. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (a private email under your name) with a concrete first task for her five hours a week. I mentioned the grant might pay her a small stipend but said it isn't certain.
